topic: Responsive UI Implementation from Figma to Code
learningObjectives: Translate Figma layouts into reusable frontend components.
Apply responsive design principles across different screen sizes.
Maintain visual consistency between designs and implemented interfaces.

activities.title: Design-to-Code Map
activities.instruction: Explore how common Figma design elements translate into frontend implementation decisions.

content.concept: Design-to-code work translates frames into page structures, components into reusable UI pieces, design tokens into CSS values, and layout constraints into responsive rules.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Can map to a page, section, or application screen in the implementation.
Can become a reusable frontend component.
Can inform flexbox or other layout behavior that adapts to content.
Can map to reusable CSS values such as colors, spacing, or typography.
Can guide the implementation of navigation, events, or UI state changes.

activities.title: Responsive Layout Lab
activities.instruction: Adjust the viewport and observe how the layout should adapt.

content.concept: Responsive interfaces adapt their layout, spacing, sizing, and component behavior to different viewport sizes instead of simply shrinking a desktop layout.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Component Mapping
activities.instruction: Choose the implementation approach that best preserves reusable design patterns.

content.concept: Repeated visual patterns should normally become reusable components. This reduces duplication and makes updates more consistent across an application.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Create one reusable Card component and render it with different data
Copy and modify the same card markup separately on every page
config.answer: Create one reusable Card component and render it with different data

activities.title: Responsive Page Builder
activities.instruction: Compose a responsive page using reusable components and layout rules.

content.concept: A responsive implementation combines reusable components, flexible layout systems, breakpoints, design tokens, and content-aware sizing to maintain consistency across devices.
